modules.name: WING-LINK
modules.description: Bridge to a Behringer WING over USB: 8 tracks as USB audio, names, colours and icons on the WING channels, faders, pan, sends, mute and solo both ways, CV in and out

modules.name: WING-LINK X
modules.description: Expander for WING-LINK: 8 more WING channels (docks right of WING-LINK, or links by right-click)

modules.name: WING-FX
modules.description: The WING's 16 effects from Rack, 4 at a time: model, on, mix and four parameters both ways, CV, delays in Rack's tempo or the WING's tempo as a clock (a panel of WING-LINK)
